page.layout: Two columns side by side on one printed page. Left column: entries, then a centred letter heading (י ת) and further entries. Right column: entries to the foot. Below the right column: signature "C c" at left and catchword "R." at right. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: יִשְׁתַּקְשְׁקוּן discurfitabunt, fut. Hithp. gem. 3. pl. m. Rad. שָׁקַק[?].
יִשְׁתָּרְגוּ implicabuntur, fut. Hithp. 3. pl. masc. Rad. שָׁרַג.
יִשָּׁתְרוּ occulti erunt, pro יִסָּתְרוּ, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. Rad. סָתַר.
וַיָּבֹא & venit, Deut. 33. 21. pro וַיֵּאָתֶה; fut. Kal, 3. f. s. m. R. אָתָה.
וַיִּתְאַו & desideravit, וַיִּתְאַוּ & desideraverunt, fut. Hithp. 3. f. m. apoc. (pro וַיִּתְאַוֶּה) & 3. pl. m. R. אָוָה.
יִתְאַנָּן quiritabitur, fut. Hithp. 3. f. m. R. אָנַן.
יִתְאָרֶהוּ, & יִתְאַרֶּהוּ formabit eum, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. aff. R. תָּאַר.
יִתְבּוֹלֵל confundet, fut. Hithp. 3. sing. m. Rad. בָּלַל.
יִתְבּוֹנָן intelliget, יִתְבּוֹנְנוּ intelligent, fut. Hithp. 3. f. & pl. m. R. בִּין.
יִתְבּוֹשְׁשׁוּ erubescent, fut. Hithp. 3. pl. m. Rad. בּוּשׁ.
יִתְבָּרְרוּ purificabuntur, fut. Hithp. 3. pl. m. Rad. בָּרַר.
יִתְגּוֹדְדוּ turmatim conve-nient, fut. Hithp. 3. pl. m. Rad. גָּדַד.
יִתְגּוֹרְרוּ congregabunt se, fut. Hithp. 3. pl. m. Rad. גָּרַר, vel גּוּר.
וַיִּתְגַּל & retexit se, fut. Hithp. 3. f. m. apoc. (pro יִתְגַּלֶּה) Rad. גָּלָה.
יִתְגָּרֵחַ miscebit, fut. Hithp. 3. f. m. R. גָּרַח.
יִתְדּוֹתָיו paxilli ejus, (viri) וַיִּתְדּוֹתֶיהָ & paxilli ejus, (faeminae) &c. pl. fem. aff. No. f. יִתְדָּהּ, à No. Rad. f. יִתְד paxillus.
יִתְהַלֵּל, & יִתְהַלֵּל jactabit se, fut. Hithp. 3. f. m.

page.notes: Printed page number read as 201, slightly blurred. Running head is the Hebrew letters י ת on both columns. Several Hebrew vowel points and the Rad. forms are small and blurred, so they are marked [?] where doubtful; the second word in the paxilli entry and the fem. aff. form are uncertain. The entry at the foot of the right column appears to continue on the next page. The centred י ת is a bare letter and is written as a paragraph, not a heading.
